consumer_contract.observed_invocation: subprocess.Popen([libredwg, dwgfilename, '-o', result]); checks resulting file presence
consumer_contract.test_scope: Harness uses that argument order with local input/output paths, including spaces and non-ASCII paths, and checks successful source-version retention, strict refusals, existing-output atomicity and installed CLI loader behavior.

build.consumer_guard_scope: lc3_compat_check mirrors a LibreCAD_3 DRW_Interface subclass and includes selected LibreCAD facade signature checks; compilation checks source compatibility only. Review of the committed header diff found no change to the existing DRW_Interface declaration, base-class layout or vtable; the provider is a separate opt-in interface.

inputs: Locally generated AC1027 DWG from libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --generate-cli-batch-source, including FreeCAD-form DXF readback
Provider test's locally generated six-version drawings and collision/failure/retry controls

limits: The FreeCAD script was inspected, not executed inside the FreeCAD application. Tests exercise its converter subprocess contract, not native FreeCAD DXF import/rendering.
The installed CLI test uses a temporary prefix. It does not validate deployment on Linux or Windows.
The compile-only LibreCAD_3 mirror and selected LibreCAD signatures do not prove full external application builds, existing-binary ABI compatibility or cross-platform qualification.

Provider default/no-provider and opt-in roundtrips, failure sentinel and same-facade retry are covered by the selected provider test; this does not promote general DWG support or guarantee opaque ownership closure.
